K1 global-result repair 2026-11-15: BY Ph10.5.1 (official NTG profile) explicitly requires personal semiconductor-circuit construction and investigation. The transistor own-experiment component maps to the distinct experimental identity77ab; interpretation7d remains separately supported by the Ph10.5.2 model clause. Other diode/application components retain their existing partial targets. This does not claim every Bavarian Gymnasium profile mandates the NTG component and introduces no new track selector. Explicit remaining component: the official NTG content also includes personally investigating a transistor amplifier. That own amplifier experiment is not covered by switching-only77ab, interpretation7d/88, or supplied-material amplifieraf/144. This mapping remains partial; whole Ph10.5.1/NTG completion is not claimed. The own-amplifier component requires a subsequent coherent practical delivery. The same exact source clause explicitly requires interpreting the recorded diode characteristic. Its qualitative functional interpretation component also maps partially to dc55adac; the own-measurement requirement remains on3857891b and is not satisfied by the supplied-curve assessment8670. This is a component-level source claim, not whole-source completion.
